svg.title: Witnesses behind: keep what can be proved
svg.desc: Landmarks at tree sizes 200, 300, 400 and 500. The witnesses have only checked a checkpoint of size 350. Landmarks 1 and 2 lie inside it and are kept; landmarks 3 and 4 lie beyond it and are discarded, together with everything newer. Below, a forged hash for landmark 2 discards landmarks 2, 3 and 4 and keeps landmark 1.

text.tspan: the CA ships a forged hash for landmark 2
a failure discards that landmark and every newer one; older landmarks stay trusted (§7.4).
